id: \rJessie: I know I heard it was here.
en: \rJessie: I know I heard it was here.
it: \rJessie: Sono sicura di aver sentito che era qui.

id: \bJames: But how are we supposed to find the Mega Evolution power?
en: \bJames: But how are we supposed to find the Mega Evolution power?
it: \bJames: Ma come facciamo a trovare il potere della Megaevoluzione?

id: \bMeowth: I think we have bigger problems right now.
en: \bMeowth: I think we have bigger problems right now.
it: \bMeowth: Mi sa che adesso abbiamo problemi più grossi.

id: \bWobbuffet!
en: \bWobbuffet!
it: \bWobbuffet!

id: \bAre you ready to lose today?
en: \bAre you ready to lose today?
it: \bSei pronto a perdere oggi?

id: \bKorrina has a new power. Be careful of it.
en: \bKorrina has a new power. Be careful of it.
it: \bKorrina ha un nuovo potere. Stai attento.

id: \bYou don't stand a chance.
en: \bYou don't stand a chance.
it: \bNon hai speranze.

id: \bGreat battle. Good luck with the rest.
en: \bGreat battle. Good luck with the rest.
it: \bGran bella lotta. Buona fortuna con il resto.

id: \rRawr!
en: \rRawr!
it: \rRoar!

id: \rKorrina will be tough. Use Flying types.
en: \rKorrina will be tough. Use Flying types.
it: \rKorrina sarà dura da battere. Usa Pokémon di tipo Volante.

id: \rVictory is at hand.
en: \rVictory is at hand.
it: \rLa vittoria è a portata di mano.

id: \rYou're halfway there.
en: \rYou're halfway there.
it: \rSei a metà strada.

id: \rKorrina: So you finally made it. I've been waiting for you to show up.
en: \rKorrina: So you finally made it. I've been waiting for you to show up.
it: \rKorrina: Finalmente sei arrivato. Ti stavo aspettando.

id: \rWith help from you, I've got my hands on the power boost for Lucario. With it we won't lose against you.
en: \rWith help from you, I've got my hands on the power boost for Lucario. With it we won't lose against you.
it: \rGrazie al tuo aiuto, ho messo le mani sul potenziamento per Lucario. Con questo non perderemo contro di te.

id: \rYou've earned the Rumble Badge.
en: \rYou've earned the Rumble Badge.
it: \rHai ottenuto la Medaglia Lotta.

id: \rHere, have this TM too.
en: \rHere, have this TM too.
it: \rEcco, prendi anche questa MT.

id: \rTM114 contains Aura Sphere. This move never misses.
en: \rTM114 contains Aura Sphere. This move never misses.
it: \rLa MT114 contiene Forzasfera. Questa mossa non manca mai il bersaglio.

id: \rYou've earned this too. Use it with pride.
en: \rYou've earned this too. Use it with pride.
it: \rTi sei guadagnato anche questo. Usalo con orgoglio.

id: \rKorrina: With that item you should be able to Mega Evolve a Lucario.
en: \rKorrina: With that item you should be able to Mega Evolve a Lucario.
it: \rKorrina: Con quello strumento dovresti riuscire a far megaevolvere un Lucario.

id: \bKorrina uses Fighting type Pokémon. They are weak against the Flying, Psychic, and Fairy types.
en: \bKorrina uses Fighting type Pokémon. They are weak against the Flying, Psychic, and Fairy types.
it: \bOrnella usa Pokémon di tipo Lotta. Sono deboli contro i tipi Volante, Psico e Folletto.

id: \bThey are strong against Normal, Ice, Dark, Rock, and Steel. They are resistant to Bug, Dark, and Rock.
en: \bThey are strong against Normal, Ice, Dark, Rock, and Steel. They are resistant to Bug, Dark, and Rock.
it: \bSono superefficaci contro Normale, Ghiaccio, Buio, Roccia e Acciaio. Resistono a Coleottero, Buio e Roccia.
